# anthropic_service_account (Resource)

Manage a Service Account.

Requires an OAuth bearer. Admin API keys are not accepted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a service account
resource "anthropic_service_account" "example" {
  name              = "ci-deploy-bot"
  organization_role = "developer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> Slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional free-text description.
- `organization_role` (String) Org-level role. Defaults to `developer`. Value must be one of : `admin`, `developer`.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) If set, this service account is archived.
- `archived_by_actor_id` (String) Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that archived this service account.
- `created_at` (String) When this service account was created.
- `created_by_actor_id` (String) Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that created this service account.
- `id` (String) ID of the service account.
- `updated_at` (String) When this service account was last updated.
- `updated_by_actor_id` (String) Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that last updated this service account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing service account
terraform import anthropic_service_account.example <SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID>

# Example
terraform import anthropic_service_account.example svac_01SDCCSbTxrXDpWc1phhtcfK
```
